facts.text: Under the Comet Promise, Texas residents with a family income of $100,000 or less have tuition and fees covered through scholarships, grants, and institutional funding.

sources.title: Comet Promise | University of Texas at Dallas
sources.quote: Eligible students will have their tuition and fees covered through scholarships, grants and tuition exemptions from federal, state and institutional funds with any remaining tuition costs covered by Comet Promise funding.

sources.title: Comet Promise | University of Texas at Dallas
sources.quote: Have a family income of $100,000 or less.
